mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.inviter_user_id, r.invited_user_id, r.reward_amount, r.reward_status, r.create_time, r.update_time, inviter.nick_name as inviter_nick_name, inviter.user_name as inviter_user_name, invited.nick_name as invited_nick_name, invited.user_name as invited_user_name from ai_invite_record r left join sys_user inviter on inviter.user_id = r.inviter_user_id left join sys_user invited on invited.user_id = r.invited_user_id
mapper.select: select coalesce(count(1), 0) as total_invites, coalesce(sum(case when reward_status = 'GRANTED' then reward_amount else 0 end), 0) as total_reward_credits, coalesce(sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as today_invites from ai_invite_record where inviter_user_id = #{inviterUserId}
